focus_area_title: Show Your Employees You Care About Them
content_text_body:
Seeking and embracing opportunities to connect on a human level with your team is the first step to show them that you care. 

First, read this [article](https://www.inc.com/adam-fridman/5-ways-to-build-a-culture-of-caring.html) on ways to build a culture of caring to recognize which recommendations you can start implementing with your team.

### Remember to encourage your employees to be their best selves
Dedicate time to learn more about their aspirations and career goals. Meet with them in weekly one-on-ones to give each employee individual attention. Ask what's on their mind. Listen to their fears, goals and desires. Empower them to continue learning and encourage them to engage in development opportunities such as training, mentoring sessions, and professional conferences.   

### Show you trust them and offer autonomy
Recognize their skills and trust their ability to engage in projects with new responsibilities. This can open spaces for them to innovate and further enhance their skills. Show them you believe in them and trust them to do their best work with no need to micromanage.

### Be transparent
Sharing honest feedback on their performance will help you to show you care about their growth and success. Maintain authenticity by highlighting their accomplishments and discussing potential areas to improve. 

Read this [article](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/six-simple-habits-caring-managers-heather-r-younger-j-d-/) to learn more about habits of caring managers.
